chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
I wonder about the man who loses hope despite the possibility of seeking forgiveness.
ai.seo_question: Why should one not despair of God's mercy when seeking forgiveness?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) highlights the paradox of despairing while possessing the active means of repentance, a concept central to Shia theological optimism regarding divine mercy. This narration underscores that istighfar is not merely a ritual but a dynamic spiritual state that keeps the door to forgiveness open, contrasting with the despair of those who believe their sins are too great for God's pardon.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 87. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
I wonder about the man who loses hope despite the possibility of seeking forgiveness.
